about: Where every file in brand/ came from, with its SHA-256. build.py refreshes the hashes.

README.md.source: the usage sheet for this brand home, written for the audit of 2026-09-28

brand.json.source: written 2026-09-28 for this brand home: names the masters, the icon palette for the 16/32 px grids, and the surface files that are copies of brand files

svg/lockdocs-app-icon.svg.source: specified by the brand lead in the audit of 2026-09-28: the symbol on a #06080C rounded square (rx 22% of the 1024 side), symbol at 70% width, centred

svg/lockdocs-maskable.svg.source: svg/lockdocs-app-icon.svg without the corner radius, so masks that crop (Android maskable, Apple touch) have a full-bleed square

svg/lockdocs-symbol-black.svg.source: one-colour version of svg/lockdocs-symbol.svg: every fill and stroke set to #000000, with the two document lines cut out of the lock body using fill-rule="evenodd" so they stay visible

svg/lockdocs-symbol-white.svg.source: one-colour version of svg/lockdocs-symbol.svg: every fill and stroke set to #FFFFFF, with the two document lines cut out of the lock body using fill-rule="evenodd" so they stay visible

svg/lockdocs-symbol.svg.source: docs/public/logo.svg moved here 2026-09-28; git history for that path starts at d4c4d54 (2026-09-25, 'feat: lockdocs 0.1 - exact-version library docs from your lockfile, offline (#1)') and the drawing is unchanged. build.py copies it back to docs/public/logo.svg.

tokens.json.source: the colours and the type face the product already shipped: the logo's three colours, the docs theme's background and accent roles (docs/.vitepress/theme/custom.css) and the theme's Inter stack
